selected_evidence.summary: opsadmin exists; authorized_keys exactly matches the requested key, is owned by opsadmin, has mode 0600, and has the ssh_home_t SELinux type.

Effective sshd configuration enables public keys, disables password and keyboard-interactive authentication, and requires AuthenticationMethods publickey. A live connection without a key was rejected with Permission denied (publickey).

Healthy baseline boot ID a0d04bc6-5f90-4c7b-8283-51dd6932056f was captured; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to dff20be0-4b08-4224-bd8b-1429447f658c. sshd recovered active/enabled and listening, the exact key and permissions persisted, effective key-only policy remained intact, and the live SSH handshake still offered only publickey authentication.
